content.rendered:
We hope everyone can join us on Thursday, August 28th for the Meet and Greet event! It is a great opportunity for students to meet their teachers, see the classroom, drop off school supplies and get the first day jitters out – before the first day of school!

When you arrive, please head straight to your child’s classroom to drop off school supplies. In the classroom you will receive a meet and greet packet with your checklist of things to do. Be sure to visit the gym to pick up your car line tags for the year! See suggested arrival times below:

Student last name A-H: 1:00-2:00 pm

Student last name J-Z: 2:00-3:00 pm
